answer_1.quote: We use GPT-4o to generate a document-level synthetic parallel corpus by forward-translating English Europarl into seven diverse low-resource languages.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the quality of the generated parallel dataset, we compute two neural metrics at the segment level: Bicleaner-AI and COMETKiwi.

answer_4.quote: To further assess the quality of our synthetic dataset, we conduct a human evaluation for five languages. For each of language pair, we randomly sample 100 sentences and ask native speakers to evaluate them.
answer_4.guideline: Direct Assessment (DA) protocol from the WMT2017 Shared Task
